facts.text: Every inch of this tower is state of the art, even the lunch. Nothing could possibly go wrong.
facts.why: No source I could open gives Daniel Clamp this line. It reads like an invented speech, so it is flagged. A written note in his voice is safer.
facts.fix: Welcome to Clamp Center. Lunch is on me, and the lab floor is closed to visitors.

fix_note.text: Welcome to Clamp Center. Lunch is on me, and the lab floor is closed to visitors.

vibe.verdict: The office tower setting works and the dish names nod to the lab, but the menu is a plain canteen and misses the film's wilder gremlins.
missing: Microwave Marge, the cooking show host (Kathleen Freeman)
The Brain Gremlin as leader of the pack
The Spider Gremlin on the ceiling
The vegetable gremlin from the Splice O' Life lab
Gizmo dressed as Rambo with his bow
Not feeding gremlins after midnight (the rule the whole film bends)
ideas: Swap 'Top-floor steak Diane' note for a Brain Gremlin dish, for example 'Brain Gremlin pâté on toast'.
Print the vegetable gremlin rice paper rolls, which are in the data but not on the card.
Add a Gizmo Rambo drink, a lychee fizz with a red headband on the glass, replacing the plain Mogwai fizz note.
Give the canteen a Microwave Marge recipe card as the prop in place of the generic badge.
